description: The copropriété(s) the Registre national d'immatriculation des copropriétés (RNIC, Anah, Licence Ouverte 2.0) registers at a street address, matched by cadastral parcel (BAN geocoding then IGN API Carto), else by normalised address, else within 50 m (marked probable, with the distance): name, immatriculation number, lots, construction period, syndic type and name, whether a mandate is running, any mandat ad hoc, administration provisoire or état de carence, any arrêté (insalubrité, péril, équipements communs), residence service, last update, and alerts. The register does not say which works were voted in general meetings: the answer lists the documents to demand from the seller (minutes of the last 3 AGs, pré-état daté, PPPT/DTG, next AG's convocation, fiche synthétique and carnet d'entretien). A principal and its secondary syndicates are all returned. Cite "Registre national des copropriétés — Anah".

address.description: Street address with its postcode or city (e.g. "138 boulevard de la Mer, 62152 Neufchâtel-Hardelot").

place.description: City or postcode the address is in, when the address does not say.

name: copro_at_address
title: Copropriété(s) registered at an address (France)
